limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses immortalized fibroblast lines, which may not fully recapitulate primary CAF behavior.
In vivo experiments are limited to subcutaneous matrix plug assays and may not reflect orthotopic tumor stroma.
The feed-forward loop model is based on pharmacological inhibition and siRNA knockdown; genetic knockout models are not used.
The role of TAZ is not fully separated from YAP in some experiments.
The mechanism of Src activation downstream of actomyosin tension is not fully elucidated.
The study does not address whether YAP activation in CAFs is reversible in established tumors in vivo beyond the plug model.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
